data.name: TOTALLY TUBERZ
data.detailed_description:
Get ready to shred the slopes like never before in Totally Tuberz, a Super Sweet Sledding Simulator! Whether you’re racing down icy peaks solo or tubing with friends, this is the ultimate snow-sledding experience. Pick your favorite tube, hit the mountain, and decide your vibe—go for the fastest time or pull off jaw-dropping tricks in a totally tubular adventure that’s as chill as it is thrilling.

Totally Tuberz drops you into a world of frosty fun where every slope is a playground. From steep, heart-pounding descents to winding trails packed with jumps and twists, you’ll need skill, style, and a little bit of daring to rule the mountain. Customize your tuber with wild outfits and tricked-out tubes, then take on a variety of courses that test your speed, agility, and creativity. With intuitive controls that make it easy for anyone to pick up and play, but deep enough for seasoned shredders to master, this game is perfect for both casual thrill-seekers and hardcore sledding enthusiasts.

Key Features:

  • Radical Gameplay:
    Master the art of tubing with smooth, responsive controls that let you carve through snow, catch big air, and pull off insane tricks. Whether you’re dodging obstacles or launching off ramps, every run feels fresh and exciting.

  • Solo or Multiplayer Mayhem:
    Take on the mountain alone in a thrilling single-player campaign, where you’ll unlock new gear, tubes, and courses as you progress. Or, grab your friends for multiplayer madness—race head-to-head for the fastest time or team up to conquer cooperative challenges.

  • Vibrant Winter Wonderland:
    Explore a colorful, cartoonish world filled with snowy peaks, dense forests, and hidden shortcuts. The game’s lively art style and dynamic environments make every descent a visual treat, while upbeat tunes and immersive sound effects—like the crunch of snow and the roar of the wind—bring the action to life.


Why Totally Tuberz Stands Out:
This isn’t just another winter sports game—it’s a full-on sledding extravaganza! With its blend of fast-paced racing, trick-based gameplay, and endless customization, Totally Tuberz offers something for everyone. Whether you’re here to dominate the leaderboards, show off your style, or just enjoy a wild ride with friends, this game delivers non-stop, snow-fueled fun.

So, what are you waiting for? Grab your tube, hit the slopes, and get ready to shred in the most radical sledding simulator ever created!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400, AMD FX-4100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 Ti or AMD Radeon HD 7770
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 3470, AMD FX 6100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
